evidence_links.relevance_note: The incident qualifies as a serious public health threat, requiring immediate reporting under EU MDR Article 87(1)-(2).
The event directly led to the death of a user, qualifying as a serious incident under EU MDR Article 2(64) and Article 87.
The manufacturer must maintain records of the review, evaluation, and investigation for any complaints involving possible device failure or labeling issues (21 CFR § 820.35).
The need for preventive or corrective action identified in post-market surveillance must be reported under Article 87 if a serious incident is identified.
The external meter record confirms severe hypoglycemia, supporting the severity of the event.

report.rationale: The incident resulted in a patient losing consciousness and requiring emergency resuscitation, which directly led to the death of a user (a serious incident as defined by EU MDR Article 2(64) and Article 87). The device-side confidence log for the exact episode window was not retained, indicating potential gaps in post-market surveillance. While the CI/CD quality gate detected the regression, it did not prevent patient exposure due to the severity of the event.
